blocks.html: The data to create a shipping method for a claim.

types.name: CreateClaimShippingMethodWorkflowInput
types.description: The data to create a shipping method for a claim.

children.name: return_id
children.description:
The ID of the return associated with the claim.
If this is set, the shipping method will be created as an inbound (return) shipping method.
If not set, the shipping method will be created as an outbound (delivering new items) shipping method.

children.name: claim_id
children.description: The ID of the claim to create the shipping method for.

children.name: shipping_option_id
children.description: The ID of the shipping option to create the shipping method from.

children.name: custom_amount
children.description: A custom amount to set for the shipping method. If not set, the shipping option's amount is used.
